units.text: **Type species.** Crenuladesha narendrani (Ranjith), comb. nov. by monotypy.
units.label: Type species

units.text: **Diagnosis.** Differs from all other genera of Adeshini in having a complete, partially crenulate, mid-longitudinal propodeal groove, other genera having at least a partial, and usually complete, mid-longitudinal carina.
units.label: Diagnosis

units.text: In addition, unlike other members of the tribe the basal lobe of the claws is distinctly pectinate, and the dorsal valve of the ovipositor has a distinct pre-apical angulation in lateral profile, rather than being smoothly rounded.
units.label: Diagnosis

units.text: **Description. Head.** Scapus shorter ventrally than dorsally in lateral aspect.
units.label: Description

units.text: Terminal flagellomere acute.
units.label: Description

units.text: Head transverse. Antennal sockets strongly produced in front of the eyes.
units.label: Description

units.text: Head smooth, setose. Malar suture distinct and complete.
units.label: Description

units.text: Frons depressed behind antennal sockets with mid-longitudinal groove.
units.label: Description

units.text: **Mesosoma.** Mesosoma smooth and densely setose.
units.label: Description

units.text: Mesoscutum without mid-longitudinal groove medio-posteriorly.
units.label: Description

units.text: Notauli crenulated, not meeting posteriorly.
units.label: Description

units.text: Scutellar sulcus crenulated.
units.label: Description

units.text: Scutellum smooth, setose.
units.label: Description

units.text: Median area of metanotum with complete mid-longitudinal carina.
units.label: Description

units.text: Mesopleuron smooth and setose, glabrous medially.
units.label: Description

units.text: Pleural suture smooth. Metasternum smooth.
units.label: Description

units.text: Propodeum with crenulated mid-longitudinal groove, with large crenulations posteriorly.
units.label: Description

units.text: **Wings.** Fore wings broad without infuscation.
units.label: Description

units.text: Second submarginal cell 2.50× as long as wide.
units.label: Description

units.text: Fore wing vein 2CUb longitudinal.
units.label: Description

units.text: Hind wing vein R longitudinal.
units.label: Description

units.text: Posterior margin of hind wing weakly emarginate.
units.label: Description

units.text: Base of hind wing without glabrous area next to vein cua.
units.label: Description

units.text: **Legs.** Tarsal claws with acute, pectinate basal lobe.
units.label: Description

units.text: **Metasoma.** Metasoma with five tergites, rugose.
units.label: Description

units.text: First metasomal tergite with medially united dorsal carina which extend to posterior margin in the form of a mid-longitudinal carina.
units.label: Description

units.text: Second metasomal tergite with smooth, triangular mid-basal area and a short mid-longitudinal carina, pair of posteriorly converging antero-lateral grooves.
units.label: Description

units.text: Second metasomal suture crenulate.
units.label: Description

units.text: Fifth metasomal tergite distinctly emarginated postero-laterally.
units.label: Description

units.text: Ovipositor with distinct dorsal angulation and ventral serrations.
units.label: Description

units.text: **Etymology.** From the combinations of Latin “crenula” meaning notched and Adesha type genus of the tribe, in reference to the crenulate propodeal groove.
units.label: Etymology

units.text: **Remarks.** The distinct and complete malar suture and crenulated mid-longitudinal groove on the propodeum are putative autapomorphies of Crenuladesha Ranjith & Quicke, gen. nov. In addition to that the presence of postero-lateral semicircular emarginations of the fifth metasomal tergite displays some affinities with the Adesha, Furcadesha and Indadesha.
units.label: Remarks

units.text: In common with Adesha, Aneuradesha, Furcadesha and Spinadesha are the presence of a mid-longitudinal groove on the frons, smooth vertex, mesosternum and pleural suture and exhibit a lesser character sharing with Africadesha, Aneuradesha and Protadesha on the basis of a single character; smooth mesosternum.
units.label: Remarks

units.label: Type species

units.text: **Diagnosis.** Differs from all other genera of Adeshini in having fore wing vein 2CU with a clearly-differentiated and sub-transverse basal abscissa (2CUa).
units.label: Diagnosis

units.text: **Description. Head.** Scapus shorter ventrally than dorsally in lateral aspect.
units.label: Description

units.text: Head transverse. Head and mesosoma largely finely coriaceous or alutaceous.
units.label: Description

units.text: **Mesosoma.** Mesonotum with very weak narrow mid-longitudinal groove.
units.label: Description

units.text: Notauli narrow, complete, more or less uniting shortly before scutellar sulcus.
units.label: Description

units.text: Precoxal sulcus absent. Median area of metanotum with weak, mid-longitudinal carina.
units.label: Description

units.text: Propodeum with mid-longitudinal carina.
units.label: Description

units.text: **Wings.** Wings narrow. Fore wing second submarginal cell approximately 1.50× longer than wide.
units.label: Description

units.text: Fore wing vein 2CUa distinct.
units.label: Description

units.text: Hind wing vein 1r-m short, oblique.
units.label: Description

units.text: Hind wing vein R longitudinal.
units.label: Description

units.text: Posterior margin of hind wing weakly emarginate.
units.label: Description

units.text: Base of hind wing without glabrous area next to vein cu-a. **Metasoma.**
units.label: Description

units.text: Metasoma with five fully visible and sculptured tergites; tergites deep with steep sides.
units.label: Description

units.text: Metasomal tergites 3–5 without transverse subposterior grooves.
units.label: Description

units.text: First metasomal tergite not flattened laterally; with weak lateral depression along ventrolateral margin; with small, fenestrate dorsope.
units.label: Description

units.text: Second metasomal tergite without mid-basal or antero-lateral areas, with wide, weak lateral depression that runs along lateral margin as far as the base of third tergite.
units.label: Description

units.text: Second metasomal suture narrow, weakly curved.
units.label: Description

units.text: Fifth metasomal tergite very weakly emarginated posterolaterally.
units.label: Description

units.text: Ovipositor sharp, with a distinct pre-apical dorsal angulation (nodus).
units.label: Description

units.text: **Etymology.** From Greek proto meaning first and the genus name Adesha in reference to the potentially earlier form of modification of the fore wing venation in relation to that of other Adeshini.
units.label: Etymology

units.text: **Remarks.** The position of fore wing vein 2CUb half-way between the level of 2CU and the anal vein (hence with two angled abscissa of 2CU present) is intermediate between the usual condition in Braconinae and the derived state of the Adeshini, suggesting that the genus might be displaying a transitional character state.
units.label: Remarks
